mapper.sql: SELECT s.skill_id,s.publisher_id,p.user_id,v.version_id,v.artifact_id,s.slug,v.version_label, a.archive_key,a.archive_sha256,a.archive_bytes FROM t_skill_version v JOIN t_skill s ON s.skill_id=v.skill_id AND s.current_version_id=v.version_id JOIN t_skill_publisher p ON p.publisher_id=s.publisher_id JOIN t_skill_artifact a ON a.artifact_id=v.artifact_id WHERE v.version_id=#{versionId} AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND v.status='AVAILABLE' AND a.status='READY'
mapper.select: AND s.skill_id=#{skillId} AND EXISTS (SELECT u.user_id FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id=p.user_id AND u.status=1 AND u.del_flag=0)
SELECT p.user_id FROM t_skill_version v JOIN t_skill s ON s.skill_id=v.skill_id JOIN t_skill_publisher p ON p.publisher_id=s.publisher_id WHERE v.version_id=#{versionId}
